title: The Kadets--Werner modification of Bourgain--Rosenthal space is asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex
summary: Let $X_{\mathsf{KW}}$ be the Kadets--Werner modification of a closed subspace of $L_1$ constructed by Bourgain and Rosenthal in 1980. In this short note, it is shown that $X_{\mathsf{KW}}$ is asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex. Since $X_{\mathsf{KW}}$ has the Daugavet Property, it fails the Point of Continuity Property and thus does not admit an equivalent norm that is asymptotically uniformly convex. Therefore, the previously known properties of $X_{\mathsf{KW}}$ and the new geometric observation answer, in the negative, the question of Dilworth, Kutzarova, Randrianarivony, Revalski…
